Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial sided knee pain for 2 months, patient is a runner.
Comparison: Radiographs of the left knee 2/[DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Moderate osseous stress involving the patella. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects./

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with superimposed low-grade interstitial partial-thickness tearing of the anterior mid fibers. Superimposed osseous stress involving the patella..
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Mechanical stress across the extensor mechanism characterized by mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing, as well as superimposed edema throughout the patella.

Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Keine relevanten Degenerationen. Flächige Signalalterationen an der Patellabasis (8/8) mit partieller Assoziation zur Quadricepssehne als mögliches Schmerzkorrelat. MR-morphologisch kein eindeutiger Frakturnachweis. Ansonsten allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Allenfalls minimale Signalalterationen des retropatellaren Knorpels der medialen Facette (4/14). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Regelrechte Konfiguration der Menisken ohne H.a. Rissbildung. Akzentuiert Gelenkflüssigkeit. Bakerzyste. Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain. 
Comparison: [REDACTED]. 

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar and multisequence MRI of the left  knee without IV contrast.   

FINDINGS: 

JOINT EFFUSION:  No significant knee joint effusion. Small complex popliteal cyst. 

ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

MEDIAL MENISCUS: Complete tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Associated moderate peripheral extrusion, with the meniscal body projecting 5 mm beyond the tibial margin. There is also a horizontal undersurface tear of the meniscal body. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  There is partial and full-thickness cartilage loss involving the medial tibial plateau with mild degree of subchondral bone marrow edema. There is also mild thinning of the femoral cartilage. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Proximal thickening of the medial collateral ligament, representing sequela of prior sprain. 

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: There is a focal full-thickness cartilage fissure of the lateral patellar facet, with mild full-thickness delamination. Moderate degree of associated subchondral bone marrow edema. Trochlear cartilage is intact. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 

BONE MARROW:  No fracture. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Complete tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus, with moderate peripheral meniscal extrusion. There is also a horizontal undersurface tear of the posterior body.

2. Mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Full-thickness cartilage fissure of the lateral patellar facet.

4. Small popliteal cyst.

Unveränderter Reizzustand der Patellarsehne bei artikulärseitig dem Patellaunterpol angrenzendem Ödem. Überwiegend oberflächliche Chondropathie an der retropatellaren Gelenkfläche teils konstant, an der lateralen Facette progrediente chondrale Signalalteration, V. a. mäßiggradige Chondropathie (7/16). Konstant kleine osteophytäre Ausziehung an der Trochlea (1011/166) mit subchondralem Ödem der gegenüberliegenden inferioren Patella. Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Unauffälliges Knochenmarksignal. Keine Fraktur. Meniskus intakt. Weichteile unauffällig. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit.

Impressionsfraktur des lateralen Tibiaplateaus mit deutlicher Impression der Gelenkfläche mit entsprechendem Knorpeldefekt und angrenzendem Bonebruise Areal des lateralen Tibiaplateaus. Geringes Bonebruise Areal auch am medialen Tibiaplateau sowie der medialen Femurcondyle. Darüber hinaus kein weiterer Frakturnachweis an den ossären Strukturen. Initial degenerative Veränderungen. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und im lateralen Kompartiment. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus im Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn. Geringe Signalalterationen des Außenmeniskus, insbesondere am Vorederhorn ohne eindeutige Rissbildung. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Bakerzyste. Gering subcutane Einblutungen.

 Intercondylar notch

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: One month of knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Focal subchondral marrow edema at the anterior peripheral margin of the medial tibial plateau. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, multiloculated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: High-grade radial tear of the posterior root with moderate peripheral extrusion and superimposed complex tearing of the body and posterior horn.
Medial compartment cartilage: Large areas of full-thickness chondrosis along the weightbearing femoral condyle with underlying subchondral cystic change/edema. Diffuse high-grade tibial cartilage loss with full-thickness loss at the peripheral margin.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the femoral condyle and tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss along the superior aspect of the medial patellar facet with underlying subchondral cystic change and edema. Diffuse thinning of the trochlear cartilage, without focal defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact, with thickening of the proximal ligament suggestive of prior injury. Bowed morphology and periligamentous edema likely secondary to meniscal extrusion.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Moderate to severe medial compartment osteoarthritis with complex meniscal tearing and reactive subchondral edema at the peripheral medial tibial plateau.

Заключение: МР данни за прясна субтотална руптура на предната кръстна връзка. Хеморагичен ставен излив.
